title: Unique Dense Italian Yoghurt Toast
description: A traditional Venetian dish featuring natural yoghurt and double-rise-bread, this Unique Dense Italian Yoghurt Toast is a sour and dense treat. It is a nut-free-friendly option perfect for a snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Slice the double-rise-bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the natural yoghurt, honey, lemon zest, lemon juice, and salt until well combined.
Brush the toasted bread slices with the melted unsalted butter.
Spread a layer of the yoghurt mixture onto each toasted bread slice.
Top each slice with a sprinkle of chopped fresh mint leaves.
Place the slices on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 5 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a minute or two before serving.
